ways.label: SH73 near the Mingha confluence over Taruahuna Pass and down the Otehake to SH73 at Aickens

start.name: SH73 by the Bealey-Mingha confluence
start.quote: SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village, just after the Mingha bluffs

evidence: The east-coast end of the track starts beside SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village, just after the Mingha bluffs. The west-coast end of the track starts beside SH73 at Aickens, where the Taramakau River meets the Otira River.
Cross the Bealey River just above its confluence with the Mingha River, 5 km south of Arthur’s Pass village.
The track begins at the bush edge, downstream of the Edwards-Mingha confluence.
Cross the Otira River (if fordable) over to SH73 at Aickens.

doubts: Start ref F2 is the road end where the Mingha Track meets West Coast Road (SH73); the text starts by crossing the Bealey River above the Mingha confluence 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village, which appears to be the same place, but the feature is named for the Mingha Track rather than an Edwards track. The end at Aickens has no road end feature, so the Aickens place (T4) is given. Between Taruahuna Pass and the Lake Sally side river, and below the hot springs, the text gives alternative river or track options; only the shared places are listed. The flood track to the Morrison footbridge is an emergency alternative if the Otira River cannot be forded, not recorded as a way. The walk can also be done from the Aickens end ('Parties travelling from North to South'), recorded as an access point.
